product_overview: Atlas is an interactive space encyclopedia that lets users explore the universe through a 3D solar system experience, a relational knowledge graph, and curated space content. It combines immersive navigation with premium, data-focused layouts for discovery across astronomical topics.
core_goals: Explore the 3D solar system and learn about celestial bodies through interactive discovery.
Navigate related astronomy topics through linked knowledge graph relationships.
Browse space news, events, and galaxy overviews in dedicated content sections.
Open detailed pages for specific celestial bodies to view focused information.
Switch between broad cosmic scales and specific subjects through smooth, guided exploration.

features.name: Solar System Exploration
features.description: Users can explore an interactive 3D solar system, inspect celestial bodies, and move through the scene with scrolling and mini-map navigation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to move through the solar system experience -> Observe informational panels as celestial bodies come into focus -> Hover over a planet to reveal contextual details -> Use the mini-map to jump to another section -> Continue exploring the next celestial body
Navigate to / -> Scroll through the experience -> Hover over a celestial body to inspect it -> Click an interactive body to move into its detailed context -> Observe the updated information panel

features.name: Space Categories Explorer
features.description: Users can browse high-level space categories from a dedicated exploration page.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Browse the available space categories -> Select a category of interest -> Review the category-focused content that appears

features.name: Space Events and News
features.description: Users can read about current or notable space events in a dedicated events section.
user_flows: Navigate to /events -> Browse the list of space events and news items -> Open an item to read more about it -> Continue to another event or news story

features.name: Galaxies Overview
features.description: Users can view a galaxies-focused overview page for broader cosmic structure content.
user_flows: Navigate to /galaxies -> Review the galaxies overview content -> Inspect the galaxy-related information presented on the page -> Move to another related section if desired

features.name: Celestial Body Details
features.description: Users can open a detailed page for a specific celestial body to view focused information about that object.
user_flows: Navigate to a celestial body detail page -> Review the detailed information about the selected body -> Use the content to understand its characteristics and context
